## 更新内容 / Changes

- 接入 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI。在统一实例向导中选择 Claude Code，使用 API Key、Bearer Token 或兼容 Anthropic Messages 的网关；可在创建流程中添加连接、填写地址和模型，再预览、启动或停止实例。在「供应商与密钥 → API 连接」管理已保存的 Claude 连接。支持修改地址、模型和密钥；换地址需重新填写密钥，运行中连接与过期修订会拒绝修改。
- 每个 Claude 实例使用独立配置、全局状态和会话目录。首次启动初始化欢迎流程，仍保留 Claude 的项目信任、API Key 确认与工具权限提示。保留实例 user 设置与历史，将用户可选的配置来源限定为实例 user 设置，并使用严格的空 MCP 配置。项目与 local settings 中的环境变量和 hooks 不参与启动，系统或组织管理策略仍由 Claude 执行，项目 `CLAUDE.md` 仍可读取。启动凭据通过权限为 `0600` 的临时环境文件交接，消费后删除，取消或失败时清理；不写入命令参数、恢复记录或 `settings.json`。
- Claude CLI 升级后重新解析官方安装入口，启动前检查实际命令能力；缺少隔离参数时拒绝启动。恢复已运行实例使用原启动程序路径和进程归属检查，保留停止、取消和异常恢复流程。兼容版本无需逐个加入版本名单，上游行为变化仍可能需要适配。
- 统一「会话」页增加 Claude 历史的只读查看：按来源和标题筛选、打开文件、显示文件位置、复制原始会话 ID。同 ID 记录按实例、项目和文件分别展示；不合并其他实例或 Codex 的会话。Claude 当前不支持导入导出、复制、同步、归档、删除、修复可见性、正文搜索或 Token 统计，继续对话在对应 CLI 实例中操作。

- Integrated the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS into the shared instance wizard. Select Claude Code and use an API Key, Bearer token or gateway compatible with Anthropic Messages. Add a connection, service URL and models within the creation flow, then preview, launch or stop the instance. Manage saved Claude connections in Providers and keys → API connections. Edit service URLs, models and credentials with fixed authentication types; retargeting requires key reentry, and active connections or stale revisions reject changes.
- Each Claude instance has separate configuration, global state and session directories. Initial startup configures the welcome flow while retaining Claude workspace trust, API key approval and tool permission prompts. User settings and history are retained. User-selectable setting sources are limited to instance user settings, with a strict empty MCP configuration. Project and local settings, their environment variables and hooks are excluded. System or organization managed policies still apply through Claude, and project `CLAUDE.md` files remain readable. Credentials are handed off through a temporary environment file with `0600` permissions, deleted after consumption and cleaned up on cancellation or failure. They are not written into command arguments, recovery records or `settings.json`.
- Claude CLI upgrades resolve the official installation entry point again and check actual command capabilities before launch. Missing isolation flags block startup. Recovery checks running instances against their original executable path and process ownership, preserving stop, cancellation and failure recovery. Compatible versions do not need individual version entries; upstream behavior changes can still require adaptation.
- Added read-only Claude history to the shared Sessions page: filter by source and title, open files, reveal their locations and copy original session IDs. Repeated IDs remain separate by instance, project and file, including across clients. Claude import, export, copying, synchronization, archiving, deletion, visibility repair, content search and Token statistics are not supported. Continue conversations inside the corresponding CLI instance.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和兼容 Anthropic Messages 网关连接；客户端需单独安装。Claude 的模型由连接明确声明，不套用 Codex 的 Fast、上下文配置或 OpenAI 协议。界面中的「API 连接已配置」表示凭据已配置，不代表上游鉴权已通过。

Claude 订阅 OAuth / 浏览器登录、Bedrock / Vertex / Foundry 等云模式、npm 包装启动器和 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）尚未接入。CLI 配置隔离不代表 Desktop 登录、配置与会话已经隔离，也不是项目文件的系统沙箱。

Codex desktop / CLI and the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS are supported. Claude connections use API Keys, Bearer tokens or gateways compatible with Anthropic Messages. Install clients separately. Claude models must be declared by the connection and do not inherit Codex Fast, context settings or OpenAI protocols. “API connection configured” indicates configured credentials, not successful upstream authentication.

Claude subscription OAuth / browser sign-in, cloud modes such as Bedrock / Vertex / Foundry, npm wrapper launchers and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are not integrated. CLI configuration isolation does not establish Desktop login, configuration or session isolation, and is not an operating-system sandbox for project files.

## 验证来源 / Verification

使用真实 Claude CLI **2.1.295** 进程和本地模拟 Anthropic Messages 服务验证 API Key / Bearer 请求、并发实例配置与会话隔离、同实例续接及跨实例续接拒绝；测试使用合成凭据，不访问真实付费上游。另已通过真实 CLI 的首次交互启动与正常退出验收，以及实例生命周期、取消与凭据清理、兼容性、只读会话和界面回归测试。没有真实上游付费凭据、订阅 OAuth 或 Desktop 的验收结论。

版本标签 [v0.7.0](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.7.0) 可用于核对完整来源提交。对应构建与打包检查见 GitHub Actions [Build release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml) 的本版本运行记录，安装包校验值见附件 [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.7.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)。

Real Claude CLI **2.1.295** processes were tested against a local mock Anthropic Messages service for API Key / Bearer requests, concurrent instance configuration and transcript isolation, same-instance resume and rejection of cross-instance resume. Tests used synthetic credentials without contacting a real paid upstream. Real interactive startup and clean exit were also verified. Regression coverage checks instance lifecycle, cancellation and credential cleanup, compatibility, read-only sessions and UI behavior. Real paid upstream credentials, subscription OAuth and Desktop have not been accepted by these tests.

The [v0.7.0 tag](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.7.0) identifies the complete source commit. See the matching GitHub Actions [Build release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml) run for source and packaging checks, and the attached [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.7.0/SHA256SUMS.txt) for installer hashes.
